column8: The ordered adapter retains Campaign 25 duplicate inner-join rows and applies TopN to their full `[left..., right...]` shape before returning the exact configured projection; broad Go join/executor construction remains open.

The source proof orders a configured equality join by the `USING`-hidden right signed-BIGINT key and an unprojected right primary key, then projects those keys away; all original type/key matrices remain open.
Source errors and other-condition evaluation stay in the one underlying Campaign 25 join authority; the ordered adapter creates no second join, reader, timestamp, or cancellation carrier.
The terminal adapter preserves planner-owned pushed selections by consuming already-filtered full join rows only; Go vector selection behavior remains open.
LIMIT-only requests the join one full row at a time through ConfiguredLimitStream and closes the same inputs exactly at its checked window; Go chunk sizing and arbitrary conditions remain open.

The LIMIT source proof skips/emits only its typed window and closes before the next logical join row, while TopN deliberately drains once through a bounded heap; general required-row scheduling remains open.
